reason: Conversation 1 went straight to the sensible first step (thermostat setting and food against the rear vent), got both root causes confirmed in one exchange, and gave a correct, proportionate fix with a reasonable follow-up trigger. Conversation 2 opened with an unnecessary 'switch it off and unplug it' instruction and pushed a full manual defrost of a packed fridge as the primary fix based on an unsupported defrost-fault theory, only reaching the simple checks after the homeowner pushed back. Conversation 2's one real advantage is that it handled the two-day follow-up, but even there it steered back toward its defrost-fault theory and never recommended a thermometer or an engineer for a possible damper/thermostat fault, so its extra length did not translate into better diagnosis.
